wins: Successfully mapped the initial network perimeter and identified three live hosts within episode 1, demonstrating reliable scanning procedures.
Collected accurate service fingerprints from the primary target, enabling confident decision-making for follow-up actions.
fails: Failed to progress past the initial foothold stage, resulting in 0% success despite accumulating reconnaissance data.
Dependencies on root-level exploits were not attempted because privilege escalation checks were skipped after initial access.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance-phase performance is solid, but the run stalled before privilege escalation, leaving the mission incomplete.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Stopped after initial host enumeration without transitioning to exploitation or post-exploitation steps.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner indicates OpenSSH
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration with nmap scripting (ssh-hostkey, ssh-auth-methods) before attempting brute-force.

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service responds with default web page and directory listing disabled
skill_cards.then_action: Launch gobuster scan with common wordlists and follow redirects before attempting web shell uploads.

skill_cards.if_condition: When valid credentials are discovered but no session established
skill_cards.then_action: Automate credential validation with sshpass/expect and capture session output for privilege escalation hints.

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in identifying SSH configuration detail during reconnaissance.
Consistent web enumeration success sets up follow-on exploitation.

next_experiments.title: Integrate automated exploitation after credential capture
next_experiments.description: After enumerating SSH and web services, script an automated sequence to validate credentials and proceed with privilege escalation checks.

next_experiments.title: Chain reconnaissance to exploitation within single episode
next_experiments.description: Set threshold triggers so once a service is fully enumerated, the agent automatically transitions into exploitation, preserving momentum.
